_meta.label: Boost DAO
_meta.summary: Neutron launchpad (Ignite); tokens FUEL/BOOST/YIELD; StreamSwap-derived; closed-source pending audit; one of two aDAO NFT break venues.

facts.claim: Boost DAO's launchpad (Ignite) is built on Neutron; its smart-contract source is referenced at github.com/BOOSTDAO.
Boost DAO's own disclosures name $FUEL, $BOOST and $YIELD (plus staked variants) as Platform Tokens.
Boost DAO states its smart contracts remain closed-source until completion of an external audit.
facts.notes: Do not describe the contracts as audited or open-source unless re-verified.

facts.claim: Parts of Boost DAO's contracts derive from StreamSwap, modified (timestamp→seconds system, stream storage restructure, launch-process changes) per their attribution notice.

FUEL trades on Terra as IBC denom ibc/4B44179AC2F0BEE50C16A673B3B886398988692885B2848A1C8AEF27148B3961 (origin factory denom on Neutron); the LUNA-FUEL Astroport pool is a TLA gauge pool in the project bucket.
BoostDAO Ignite is one of the two venues that support breaking an AllianceDAO NFT (the other is Atrium).
Boost DAO staking (including staked FUEL) happens on Neutron and is NOT captured by this platform; only Terra-side IBC FUEL balances are visible.
